reveal_en: Many fish species, previously thought to be silent, can produce a variety of sounds, including distinct hums, grunts, and clicks. They use specialized muscles and swim bladders to communicate.
reveal_zh: 许多鱼类并非人们想象的沉默，它们能发出各种声音，包括清晰的“哼鸣”、咕哝声和咔哒声，通过特化肌肉和鱼鳔进行交流。
meaning_en: This reveals a hidden acoustic world beneath the water, drastically changing our perception of marine life.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了水下隐藏的声学世界，彻底改变了我们对海洋生物的认知。
